items.exampleEn: That hat looks silly on you.
items.exampleZh: 那頂帽子你戴起來很滑稽。

items.exampleEn: Don't be a fool. Take your umbrella.
He has no ambition at all.
In a panic, I ran out of the house.
items.exampleZh: 我驚慌失措地跑出屋外。

items.exampleEn: The rules of this game are unfair.
items.exampleZh: 這個遊戲的規則很不公平。

items.exampleEn: People and animals live in harmony here.
items.exampleZh: 這裡的人和動物和諧共處。

items.exampleEn: The dog ran happily to the door.

items.sentenceEn: It's unfair that I have to clean the room alone.
items.sentenceZh: 要我一個人打掃房間太不公平了。

items.audioEn: I regret not taking more photos on the trip.
items.audioZh: 我很後悔旅行時沒多拍一些照片。
options: Not buying more gifts for friends

items.sentenceEn: Don't be silly. Of course I'll help you.
The children played happily in the garden.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們在花園裡開心地玩。

items.stemEn: Her ____ is to become a famous singer one day.
items.stemZh: 她的志向是有一天成為有名的歌手。

items.stemEn: The singers sang together in perfect ____.
items.stemZh: 歌手們一起唱出完美的和聲。

items.passageEn: Last night, the power went out during dinner. My little brother was in a panic. "It's so dark!" he said. My sister made silly faces with her phone light, and we all laughed happily. Later, my brother said, "I was a fool to be so afraid." It was unfair that the power went out on my birthday, but it became my favorite birthday. We sang together in harmony.
items.passageZh: 昨晚吃晚餐時停電了。我弟弟驚慌失措，說：「好暗喔！」我姊姊拿手機的光做鬼臉，我們全都開心地笑了。後來弟弟說：「我剛才那麼害怕真是太傻了。」在我生日這天停電實在很不公平，但那反而成了我最喜歡的一次生日。我們一起唱歌，和聲很和諧。

referenceEn: I regret that I didn't study hard.

items.instructionZh: 用 ambition 造一個句子，說說你的志向或夢想。
referenceEn: My ambition is to travel around the world.
I have an ambition to open my own cafe.
rubricZh: ambition 常寫 My ambition is to＋原形動詞
可寫例如 have an ambition to…
